title: Remove duplicate integers from an array
answer: A concise Java solution is `Arrays.stream(values).distinct().toArray()`. Because an `int[]` produces an ordered `IntStream`, `distinct()` removes repeated values while preserving first-encounter order, and `toArray()` converts the stream back to a primitive array. For example, `{4,2,4,1,2}` becomes `{4,2,1}`. This is readable and convenient but uses additional state to remember values already seen. An imperative alternative is to use a `LinkedHashSet<Integer>` when encounter order matters, then copy the unique values back into an array.
